# Avsnitt 605 - Köp inte svarta hål

**Feed**: fill-or-kill  
**Published**: 2026-11-03  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

The hosts focus on what they call 'emission chaos': loss-making biotech companies such as Orexo and BioInvent are raising money at very deep discounts, and the hosts warn listeners not to buy cash-poor biotechs around share-issue announcements. They pitch a short-term trade in UPM's newly listed plywood spin-off while index funds are forced to sell. They also discuss the US big-tech earnings sell-off (cash-flow worries about AI spending), the US midterm election, Klarna takeover rumours, Ukraine peace talks, and a contrarian look at beaten-down European stocks such as BASF.

---

## Universe Stocks

### ⛔ ORX — Orexo | **AVOID** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 80%

Rights issue at 40 öre; heavy dilution; stock kept falling after the terms were announced.

#### Reasoning

Host warns against buying after a share-issue announcement because the stock trends down in about 90% of cases. The company has no revenue, no committed major owner, and terms that destroy capital.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the stock bottoms after the issue completes and a new owner base forms

> *"Akta er för de här bolagen när de har kommit med de här meddelanden."*

---

### ⛔ BINV — BioInvent | **AVOID** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 75%

About 400 MSEK issue with no price terms yet; stock down about 70%; deep discount expected.

#### Reasoning

Hosts expect the issue price to be minimal (perhaps 1-2 SEK) with insiders committing only a token amount. They see broken trust after the earlier hype and warn against buying before the terms are set.

#### Sell Triggers

- if a licensing deal is announced
- after the issue completes, the cleaned-out shareholder base may create an opportunity

> *"det är en sån fruktansvärd kapitalförstöring"*

---

### 🟢 WISA — UPM plywood spin-off (Wisa) | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 65%

Trades at about 50 cents vs SEB estimate of 95 cents; index funds forced to sell; 6-8x earnings.

#### Reasoning

Host is repeating his spin-off playbook (Octave, Mandatum): build a position gradually around 50 cents during forced index selling and sell at about 60-65 cents. It is a profitable established business with 400 MEUR revenue and a 260 MEUR market cap. The host trades it actively and owns nothing right now.

#### Sell Triggers

- target reached at 60-65 cents
- if the forced selling continues without a bottom

> *"borde det dyka upp ett intressant för att köpa runt 50 och sen sälja runt 60-65"*

---

### 🟠 UPM — UPM | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Guest sees UPM as an energy case; its energy unit is a large share of profit.

#### Reasoning

Guest is starting to look at UPM as an underappreciated energy play with possible data centre or energy deals. Finland would also gain from peace in Ukraine. This is still early research.

#### Sell Triggers

- if no data centre or energy deal materialises

> *"jag tycker att det är intressant att se UPM lite som ett energicase"*

---

### 🟢 KYIV — Kyivstar | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Host bought ahead of the 10-11 November peace talks; plans to sell on 9 November.

#### Reasoning

An event trade on the first confirmed date for Ukraine-US-Russia talks: buy now and sell the day before the meeting.

#### Sell Triggers

- sell on 9 November before the talks
- if the talks are cancelled

> *"man borde kunna köpa den idag och sälja nionde då"*

---

### 🟠 GOOGL — Alphabet | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 55%

Down about 20% in a month; guest sees a billion-user reach for consumer AI agents.

#### Reasoning

Guest does not write Google off. Gemini is among the top models, and once Google launches a consumer agent like Muse it can reach Gmail's billion users. The stock is falling on search worries and AI spending/cash-flow concerns.

#### Sell Triggers

- if search revenue erosion accelerates
- if no consumer agent launches

> *"Jag tycker både Meta och Google är intressanta, börjar bli intressant här."*

---

### 🟠 META — Meta | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Muse agent app growing explosively while the stock is weak.

#### Reasoning

Guest finds Meta increasingly interesting because of Muse's consumer-agent success and its cost-controlled open-weight models. The market is punishing AI spending.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Muse growth stalls
- if AI spending further hurts cash flow

> *"Jag tycker både Meta och Google är intressanta"*

---

### 🟡 NBIS — Nebius | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Host bought on the AI bounce and trades it actively; extremely volatile.

#### Reasoning

A short-term trading position after a fall from 250 to about 148. The host warns that AI names need fast stops until there is a feel for the bottom.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the downtrend continues without a bottom
- if the AI sell-off deepens after the midterms

> *"Jag har ju köpt Nibius på AI-studs igår och idag har jag handlat den."*

---

### 🟡 KLAR — Klarna | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 55%

Host owns it; takeover rumour; stock at 13-14 vs 20 before; report could move it ±20%.

#### Reasoning

Host thinks the stock is far too low and a takeover bid is a good endgame for the founder. It is misunderstood and little known in the US. The report and new partnerships could re-rate it, though a bid is unlikely soon.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the report disappoints
- if the bid rumour is dismissed

> *"jag har kvar min position här som jag har köpt här omkring"*

---

### 🟠 BAS — BASF | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Flat since 2022 while the DAX rose; a contrarian European bet on peace and lower energy prices.

#### Reasoning

Sentiment on Europe is pitch black. Peace in Ukraine plus lower gas prices could release pent-up upside in energy-intensive German industry. The guest is watching but does not own it yet.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the peace talks fail
- if energy prices rise

> *"Och jag äger inte BASF än."*

---

### 🟡 QURE — uniQure | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Guest owns it; BLA acceptance is positive; fundamentals heading the right way.

#### Reasoning

A regulatory milestone was reached (BLA application accepted) even though the stock did not react. The guest keeps the position on improving fundamentals.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the regulator rejects the application
- if a dilutive share issue comes

> *"Men fundamenta går åt rätt håll."*

---
